title: pengchujin/aerial-tv
why_read: A niche but functional open-source Android TV launcher aimed at a specific regional annoyance (ad-laden Chinese smart TV interfaces), useful mainly to that user base.
analysis: This project is a tvOS-style home screen replacement for Android-based smart TVs sold in China, designed to remove built-in advertisements and launcher bloat. Technically, it's a fairly standard Android launcher app, with the main challenge being deep integration to auto-launch on boot and bypass manufacturer restrictions. Its value is mostly practical and regional rather than offering broader technical insight for most engineers. Still, it's a legitimate ad-blocking/UX improvement tool with real-world utility for its target users.
